decision: Selected the City of Munich geoportal address point for Seidlstraße 3 (layer gsm_wfs:wahlraumfinder_adressen, feature wahlraumfinder_adressen.139390), the address Equinix publishes for both MU1 (2nd floor) and MU3 (1st floor), transformed from EPSG:25832 to WGS84, as the project locator for the two IBXs in one building. The coordinates in the map widgets on Equinix's pages were not used.

selected_properties.operator_published_address: Seidlstrasse 3, 2nd Floor (MU1) and 1st Floor (MU3), 80335 Munich (Equinix MU1 and MU3 pages, Internet Archive copies of 3 October 2026)

consistency_checks.street_query: A PropertyIsLike query 'Seidlstr*' returns 24 address points on Seidlstraße; 'Seidlstraße 3' is one feature.
consistency_checks.crs: The response declares srsName urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N).

transform_check: pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1) EPSG:25832 -> EPSG:4326, always_xy; rounded to 7 decimal places; the rounded point transforms back to within 0.003 m.

excluded_coordinates.kind: Map widget coordinates on the Equinix MU1 and MU3 pages
excluded_coordinates.reason: Map-embed parameters, which the locator policy excludes; not read or used.

excluded_coordinates.kind: Munich city centre and the Equinix MU4 site in Aschheim

limitations: The point is the municipal address point for the published address; it is not a parcel, building footprint or surveyed position, and the service states no positional accuracy. Both IBXs occupy floors of the same building, so one point serves both.
